Companion Animal Travel Desk care standard

This section sets the handling rules for all pet movement work at Aurelia Skyways and keeps every handoff calm, clean, and traceable. Staff must treat each carrier as active cargo, keep the animal secure during transfer, and confirm the paperwork before any move begins. The ground team must move slowly, avoid sudden noise, and keep carriers level between services so the pet is not startled or strained.

On arrival, check the carrier, water supply, and label details before the animal enters any holding space. If a traveler brings a pet in distress, stop the handoff, alert the senior coordinator, and keep the carrier in a quiet area away from traffic. Do not leave a pet unattended near doors, trolleys, or service lanes. Cleo and any other pet must stay under direct observation until the next approved step is complete.

When a transfer crosses lounge, relief, or quarantine space, staff must follow the posted route and use the correct access point for the station. <<FACT F027>>. If the destination is not ready, hold the pet in the assigned safe area and maintain clear written notes for the next handoff. <<FACT F023>>. The pet lounge may be used only after the receiving team confirms readiness and the carrier has been rechecked for secure closure and clean bedding.

Access control is strict. <<FACT F014>>. Never share access details with a traveler, and never let one person rely on memory when the record is available. If a label is missing, a seal is broken, or a pet appears unwell, stop the process at once and escalate without delay. Hana Vega and Aya Dubois may be reassured with plain facts, but staff must keep the work moving and avoid unnecessary discussion.

Report any shortage, injury, or mismatch to the shift lead immediately. For urgent support, contact the senior coordinator at the Companion Animal Travel Desk.
